entries.title: TFM: The First Men

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: TFM: The First Men is documented on Steam as a Windows Early Access open-world colony sim from Gathering Tree, with city-builder, base-building, survival, and strategy tags. No sourced console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass. Use Windows PC only if an Early Access archive run is acceptable, and revalidate before any final capture because the Steam page still marks the game as Early Access.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam Early Access build if provisional coverage is acceptable; otherwise wait for 1.0 and recheck the development state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Early Access game with a long-running development timeline; revalidate at 1.0 or before any final archive capture.
